scenario.name: Firewall blocking application traffic
scenario.description: A new data centre firewall rule unintentionally denies HTTPS from Singapore to the server VLAN.

incident.title: Singapore users cannot open the ERP portal
incident.description: ERP times out for Singapore users while internet access and other sites work normally.

ground_truth.root_cause: Rule FWR-DC1-0125 (BLOCK-APAC-LEGACY-WEB), committed on DC1-FW-01 at incident onset, denies TCP 443 from 10.20.0.0/16 to 10.100.100.0/24 ahead of the ERP allow rule.
